subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different user/model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible and default-preserving, but it expands the model-facing tool contract and backend `WriteOperations` contract, which is a maintainer API/product decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a dedicated append tool
options.body: Ask the PR to split append into a separate model-facing tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a narrower replacement
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if a narrower replacement proves the same behavior with a safer review surface.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership plus recent adjacent agent-runtime work make steipete the best available owner for the model-facing API decision.
